mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ai.id, ai.user_id, ai.article_title, ai.article_abstract, ai.article_cover, ai.type, ai.special_id, ai.number_times, um.nickname, um.occupation, um.avatar, fr.create_time FROM b_fabulous_record AS fr LEFT JOIN b_article_information AS ai ON fr.type_id = ai.id left join b_user_main as um on ai.user_id = um.uuid where ai.state = 0 and ai.audit_state = 2 and fr.uid = #{bo.uid} order by fr.create_time desc
